analysis:
## Technical analysis (Thursday July 2, 2026 — Bond distribution Day 8, NFP day)

**SPCX July 2:** Close $157.54 (-7.79%), AH $156.46 (-0.69%). Range $156.16–$174.95. Volume est. ~52M.

**Step aside UNCHANGED.** $157.54 is $27.46 below the $185 re-entry gate. Bond distribution Day 8 volume ~52M is lower than Day 7's 82.05M — clearance is progressing, but still 10x above the 5M/day clearance threshold. IG floor buffer: $6.16 (day low $156.16 − $150 floor) — narrowest since Day 6.

**Definitive proof: Distribution absorbs the NFP-driven spike.** Today's session structure is the strongest evidence yet that the supply overhang is macro-insensitive. NFP 57K MISS (vs 113K consensus) generated an initial rate-cut-hope spike to $174.95 — $4.09 above the prior close. Bond distribution sellers absorbed this spike; growth-scare narrative + Korea shock (KOSPI -4.45%) then drove the stock to $156.16 day low before closing at $157.54 AH $156.46. A $17.41 intraday reversal FROM A MACRO CATALYST (even one producing rate-cut hopes) confirms distribution supply overwhelms any demand at current levels.

**Volume analysis: Clearance trend restored.** Day 7's non-monotonic volume bump (82.05M vs. Day 6 est. ~70M) was the anomaly; Day 8 at ~52M resumes the declining trend. Day-by-day: 126.91M → 110M → 70M → 82.05M → 52M. The NFP day added volatility volume that partially offset clearance. Projected Day 9 (July 6): 20–35M. Day 10 (July 7 inclusion): 10–15M residual distribution + $4.3B passive. Clearance (5M/day) est. Day 11–12 (July 8–9).

**IG floor integrity: Most precarious since Day 6.** Day low $156.16 = $6.16 buffer above $150 IG floor. This is the narrowest margin since Day 6 close ($151.74) and much tighter than Day 7's $10.38 buffer. The holiday gap July 3–6 creates a scenario where Korea-shock contagion could test $150 on July 6 open with no ability to respond. Two consecutive CLOSING breaches of $150 = IG floor failure = framework reassessment required.

**Nasdaq 100 inclusion (July 7) is Day 10.** Two US trading sessions remain (July 6 = Day 9; July 7 = Day 10). The Russell 1000 template (Day 4 = June 26): $158.40 intraday → $152.15 close, fully absorbed. July 7 (Day 10) will arrive into residual distribution volume estimated at 10–15M shares. The $4.3B passive may generate a meaningful intraday spike ($165–$175 range) but absorption risk is real. Do NOT re-enter on the inclusion spike.

**Re-entry gate: $185 after clearance.** Two consecutive closes above $185 AFTER volume normalizes below 5M/day for 2–3 sessions. Est. activation: July 9–11. The gap between current price ($157.54) and re-entry gate ($185.00) is $27.46 or 14.8% — the widest it has been since the distribution began on Day 4.
